id.description: The subscription's unique identifier. This is the same value returned as `extra.autopay.subscription_id` on the Checkout API response, and it is the `subscription_id` path parameter on every subscription endpoint.

customer_id.description: Your own identifier for the customer, exactly as you sent it in `customer_id` on the checkout call that created the subscription. Use it to filter the subscription list.

customer_email.description: The customer's email address, captured when the subscription was created. Ottu sends the pre-charge, payment-failed and final-failure emails to this address.

customer_name.description: The customer's name from the checkout call that created the subscription. An empty string if the checkout call had none.

customer_phone.description: The customer's phone number from the checkout call that created the subscription. An empty string if the checkout call had none.

frequency.description: How often the customer is charged. Enum: `monthly`, `yearly`.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code that every recurring charge is made in, for example `KWD`. It is taken from the checkout transaction and cannot be changed afterwards.

recurring_amount.description: The amount charged on each billing cycle, as a decimal string in `currency`. It is independent of `first_payment_amount`.

first_payment_amount.description: The amount of the first, customer-initiated payment made at checkout, as a decimal string. `0` means the subscription started without a first charge (a free trial). `null` when no first payment applies.

start_date.description: The date billing starts from, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Its day of the month becomes the billing anchor: a subscription anchored on the 31st bills on the last day of shorter months.

end_date.description: The date after which Ottu stops billing, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. `null` for an open-ended subscription. When it passes, the subscription moves to `expired`.

billing_anchor_day.description: The day of the month every charge is due, taken from `start_date`. In a month without that day, the charge falls on the month's last day.

setup_session_id.description: The checkout `session_id` of the first payment. The webhook for that payment carries the same `session_id`, so use it to match the webhook to this subscription.

agreement_id.description: The `agreement.id` you supplied on the checkout call. It ties every charge in the subscription to the same card-on-file agreement with the customer.

amount_variability.description: Taken from the agreement: `fixed` or `variable`. `null` until the first payment is confirmed.

cycle_interval_days.description: Taken from the agreement: the number of days between charges. `null` until the first payment is confirmed.

total_cycles.description: Taken from the agreement: the total number of charges it allows. `null` until the first payment is confirmed.

notification_config.description: The `autopay.notification_preferences` you sent at creation: `pre_charge_enabled`, `failure_enabled` and `final_failure_enabled`. `null` if you sent none, which leaves all three emails on.

status.description:
The subscription's lifecycle state. One of `pending_setup` (created, first payment not completed yet), `trialing` (set up with a `0` first charge, waiting for its first billing date), `active` (billing normally), `past_due` (a billing cycle used up every retry), `canceled`, `expired` (the `end_date` passed), or `setup_failed` (the first payment never completed).

A `past_due` subscription is never canceled automatically. See [Subscription States](/developers/payments/autopay/#subscription-states).

cancel_at_period_end.description: `true` when a cancellation is scheduled for the end of the current paid period. The subscription keeps its current `status` until then. When the next billing date arrives, Ottu cancels the subscription and does not charge. `false` otherwise, including after an immediate cancellation.

cancels_on.description: When a cancellation is scheduled, the last day the customer keeps access: the day before the next charge. Ottu cancels the subscription the day after. `null` when no cancellation is scheduled, including after an immediate cancellation or a reactivation.

canceled_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the subscription became `canceled`. `null` while it is not canceled, including while a cancellation is only scheduled through `cancel_at_period_end`.

cancellation_initiator.description: Who most recently requested a cancellation: `merchant` when you called Cancel a subscription, `customer` when the customer used the self-service page. `null` if none was ever requested. It is set as soon as a cancellation is scheduled, and it is not cleared if the customer later reactivates the subscription, so read `status` and `cancel_at_period_end` to know whether the subscription is actually ending.

cancellation_reason.description: The reason the customer picked when canceling from the self-service page: `too_expensive`, `not_using`, `missing_feature`, `switched`, `temporary` or `other`. `null` when you canceled through the API or no reason was given.

cancellation_note.description: The free-text note the customer left when canceling from the self-service page. `null` when there is none.

next_billing_date.description: The date of the next scheduled charge, in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. `null` when no charge is scheduled.

description.description: The free-text label you sent in `autopay.description`, shown to the customer on the self-service page. `null` if you did not send one.

merchant_reference.description: Your checkout `order_no`, copied onto the subscription. `null` if the checkout call had none.

plan_name.description: Always an empty string for a subscription created through the Checkout API: the `autopay` block has no field for it.

language.description: `en` or `ar`, taken from the checkout `language` field at creation (default `en`). It sets the language of the customer's self-service page and of every email Ottu sends them.

retry_count.description: How many times Ottu retries a failed billing cycle before giving up, between 1 and 10. Retries run one hour apart. See [Retries & Dunning](/developers/payments/autopay/#retries-and-dunning).

created_at.description: UTC timestamp of when the subscription was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last change to the subscription, in ISO 8601 format.

masked_card.description: Masked number of the active card.

card_brand.description: Brand of the active card, such as VISA.

card.description: The card renewals are charged to: `masked_card` and `card_brand`. Never the card number or token. `null` until the first payment is confirmed. It changes when the customer updates their card on the self-service page.

scheduled_date.description: Date this billing period is or was scheduled to charge.

amount_due.description: Amount charged or attempted for this cycle.

status.description: Current billing cycle status, such as scheduled, processing, paid, retry_scheduled, failed, or canceled.

paid_at.description: Timestamp when this cycle was paid, or null if unpaid.

failure_reason.description: Gateway failure message from the last failed attempt, or null if not failed.

session_id.description: Connect session ID for the latest charge attempt, or null before any attempt.

charge_type.description: Charge type: cit, mit, or null before any attempt.

current_cycle.description: The latest attempted billing cycle, with the same fields as a cycle in Retrieve billing cycles except `payment_attempts`. `null` while `pending_setup`, and for a `past_due` subscription once its period has ended.

schema.description:
A subscription as Ottu holds it right now. Returned by Retrieve a subscription and by Cancel a subscription.

Read this object for the current state rather than caching what you sent at checkout. The customer's self-service link is deliberately not part of it; fetch that from the page-link endpoint.
schema.title: AutoPaySubscription

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, or `mode` is not `immediate` or `at_period_end`.

401.description: The API key is missing or invalid. Send your private API key as `Authorization: Api-Key <your key>`.

404.description: No subscription with this id exists on your account. Do not retry.

value.detail: Idempotency key 3f6c2a9e-8b1d-4c7a-9e2f-5d4b6a1c0e93 was already used with a different request payload.

409.description: This `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body (`code: idempotency_conflict`). Send a new key for a new request, and reuse a key only to retry the same request.

value.detail: Cancel is only allowed from pending_setup, setup_failed, trialing, active, past_due. Current status: canceled

422.description: The subscription's status does not allow a cancel, for example it has already ended (`code: invalid_transition`). Retrieve it to read its `status`.

423.description: Payments are paused on your Ottu account (`code: service_paused`), so the subscription endpoints are unavailable. Retry once payments are resumed.

503.description: The subscription service is unavailable. Retry with backoff.

504.description: The subscription service timed out, and the cancel may still have been applied. Retry with the same `Idempotency-Key`.
